models.name: X-Pro series (BEC and Opto versions)
models.firmware_note: Model table not in this manual; cutoff setting offers 2-5 LiPo cells for Opto types (4-5 Opto only); voltage rating and current not stated

entry.confirm_signal: Two low tones then two high tones ('_ _--') about 5 s after power-up.
steps: Connect the drive battery (switch on where fitted).
Wait 5 s for the two low plus two high tones.
Brake: move throttle to stop right after these tones.
Other items: keep full throttle; move throttle to stop while the wanted pattern is sounding (each shown five times).

announce.description: Each setting has its own tone pattern, repeated five times in a row; the patterns follow each other in the order of the list (battery type, under-voltage behaviour, acceleration, timing, frequency, rotation reverse, rpm control). A pattern ends after its fifth repetition. Whether the list loops is not stated. Symbols as printed: '.' beep, '-' high tone, '_' low tone, '\' falling, '/' rising, 'V' high-low-high melody, 'VV' doubled.

select.description: Move the throttle to stop while the wanted pattern is sounding.

scheme.confirm_signal: None named; the ESC leaves programming mode and is ready. The motor starts on throttle movement afterwards.
scheme.exit: Automatic after the single change. Disconnect the battery before the next change. Powering up with full throttle by mistake: disconnect the battery to avoid a change.
scheme.description: Full throttle at power-up, two low plus two high tones after 5 s. Stop right after them toggles the brake. Otherwise full throttle is kept while each setting plays as a five-times repeated tone pattern; stop during one pattern stores it. One change per entry.

items.name: Brake

values.name: toggle brake: on becomes off, off becomes on

items.note: Factory state brake off. Start-up: one beep brake on, two beeps brake off.

items.name: Battery type / cutoff

values.name: 3 LiPo cells, 8.7 V; factory default on BEC versions
4 LiPo cells, 11.6 V, Opto versions only
5 LiPo cells, 14.5 V, Opto versions only; factory default on Opto versions

items.note: Value numbers are beep counts per group; NiCd is one beep. Default: 3 LiPo (BEC) or 5 LiPo (Opto), so no single default flag.

items.name: Acceleration
items.note: Factory acceleration is 'fast'; its position among low, medium and high is not stated.

values.name: hard, 22 to 30 degrees, multipole motors (three high tones)

items.name: Active rpm control (heli mode)
items.note: Speeds refer to a 2-pole motor: divide by 2 for 4 poles, by 5 for 10 poles, by 7 for 14 poles.

unknowns: Beep and tone lengths, gaps, gap between patterns (ms): not stated.
Order in which patterns sound: printed list order assumed.
Whether the list loops after the last pattern: not stated.
Length of the brake window after the first tones ('immediately'): not stated.
Models covered: no model list in this edition.
Cutoff voltage meaning for NiCd: not stated.
notes: This 2006 edition has no LiPo autodetect, no 6 to 10 cell options and lists battery defaults per BEC/Opto version; later editions are in hacker-x-pro.
Under-voltage behaviour default is reduce power; acceleration default is fast (p2).
Power-off threshold 5.5 V or the programmed cutoff, whichever comes first (p5).
